page_title: UDI 1-1 LAZ | Udinese v Lazio 27/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Andrea Colombo to decide it wasn’t handball. The relieved Udinese players can finally celebrate.
90+7' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the Udinese goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90+5' 1 - 1 Wonderful finish from Keinan Davis (Udinese). He drills a low shot precisely into the bottom left corner. No chance for the goalkeeper.
90+5' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
90+3' The corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is cleared away by the defence.

90+2' He should have scored! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Daniele Padelli makes an easy save. The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
89' Matias Vecino (Lazio) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
88' The fouls committed statistics – 17:12.
88' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Luca Pellegrini is replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) coming on for Mario Gila.
88' Alessandro Zanoli comes off the pitch to be replaced by Matteo Palma (Udinese).
87' Here comes a substitution. Adam Buksa (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Christian Kabasele.
87' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Jesper Karlstrom will be replaced by Lennon Miller (Udinese).
86' The corner kick from Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

85' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the left post but is denied by Ivan Provedel, who pulls off a glorious save!
84' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
84' Referee Andrea Colombo sees the trip by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Udinese have a free kick from a promising distance.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Matteo Cancellieri.
80' 0 - 1 OWN GOAL! Oumar Solet (Udinese) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 1:1.
77' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
77' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
76' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

76' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.

75' Keinan Davis (Udinese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Ivan Provedel!
74' Substitution. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) has come on for Tijjani Noslin.
74' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Udinese! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Andrea Colombo and both teams have no complaints.

73' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Udinese.
73' That looked a certain handball by Mario Gila (Lazio) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
70' Adam Marusic (Lazio) plays a one-two with Reda Belahyane, but the move breaks down.
69' The total number of attempts is 8:11. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
68' Half-chance! Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) plays a pass into the box, but Daniele Padelli reacts well to snuff out the attack.
66' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) is substituted due to injury. Kosta Runjaic gives a chance to Hassane Kamara.
65' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Adam Marusic (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
62' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
62' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Udinese have a corner.
60' A player from Udinese commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

58' Oumar Solet (Udinese) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right post, but Ivan Provedel pulls off a fine save to deny him.
57' Andrea Colombo blows for a foul after Mario Gila (Lazio) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Udinese have a free kick.
55' Matias Vecino (Lazio) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
51' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
51' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
49' Oumar Solet (Udinese) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Colombo saw the whole situation.
46' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
46' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. Lazio have been awarded a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
45+2' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. Good work from Lazio as they win a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Matias Vecino (Lazio) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender.
45' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

44' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
41' Nicolo Zaniolo crosses the ball right onto the head of Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese), but his firm header from around the penalty spot shoots well wide of the right post.
40' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
40' The resulting corner from Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
39' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio). Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
39' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
36' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
35' Oumar Solet (Udinese) jumps into a tackle and Andrea Colombo signals a foul. Lazio will take a free kick.
33' Keinan Davis (Udinese) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
33' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is about to take a corner kick.
32' Keinan Davis (Udinese) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
32' 6:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 1:0.
28' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) receives a reproachful look from Keinan Davis. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
28' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
27' The game is interrupted now, Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

26' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Ivan Provedel! Udinese get a corner.
25' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but Ivan Provedel punches the ball away.
23' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

23' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
21' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
20' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).

19' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
18' A crossfield pass from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
16' Mario Gila (Lazio) brings his opponent down. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Udinese.
15' The ball possession at the moment is 48:52.
14' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
13' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
13' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
12' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle as Keinan Davis (Udinese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. A free kick to Lazio.
12' Adam Marusic (Lazio) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.

11' Matias Vecino almost found himself in a promising position after Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
8' What a shot! Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) decides to unleash a long-range missile of a shot, but his effort smashes against the right post.
6' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Ivan Provedel comes off the line to clear the ball away.
6' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) plays a terrific long ball forward to Nicolo Bertola, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
3' It could have been a good chance to score! Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) fails to release Keinan Davis with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
1' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the right post.
1' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
1' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Udinese have a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
